coverage.summary: Retained all four useful existing examples and the candidate's direct placement example. Replaced empty example method mappings with explicit supplementary method mappings and full supplied source references, distinguishing supporting source context from matching exercise types. Restored example 3 exactly and checked its endpoint calculation and diagram independently. All template references have definitions. Practice and quiz mathematics were neither altered nor re-audited. Final rendered typography and annotation spacing remain for the coordinator's visual stage.

examples.derivation: Six intervals span 2.9−2.3=0.6, giving 0.1 per interval; P is at 2.3+4×0.1=2.7. Six intervals span 8.77−8.71=0.06, giving 0.01 per interval; Q is at 8.71+2×0.01=8.73. Both diagrams match these positions. Retained supplementary reading uses the source's equal-interval placement structure.

The gap is 3.852−3.842=0.010 across five intervals, so each interval is 0.002. The offsets 0.001, 0.006 and 0.009 place the requested decimals at interval positions 0.5, 3 and 4.5. Solution coordinates 5, 30 and 45 mm match. This preserves the source's placement method, including placement between ticks.

The endpoint gap is 0.32−0.24=0.08; half is 0.04, giving midpoint 0.28. Four intervals give 0.02 per interval, so S=0.26 and T=0.30. T lies farther right and is greater. All three solution markers match. The supplied halfway context supports this retained supplementary example; it is not claimed as a matching source exercise.

Five intervals span 2.50−2.40=0.10, giving 0.02 per interval. The offset 2.46−2.40=0.06 is three intervals, so the dot belongs at the fourth tick, drawn at 30 mm. This is a different-value adaptation of source Q4's decimal-placement task.

review.summary: All 21 exact assessment locators map to one distinct assessed method: placing decimals using equal intervals. Examples 1 and 4 cover placement between ticks and at ticks. All four existing examples are retained; example 3 matches the baseline exactly and was checked for gutters, diagram adequacy and answer separation without repeating its mathematics. Formatting changes preserve the existing mathematics. No relation-led continuation requires a phantom equals gutter. Questions conceal derived answers; solution annotations agree with the working. Solution prose and mathematics inherit the confirmed blue styling, while diagram ink remains black. Supplied source text and images provide sufficient evidence. Final label sizing and annotation spacing remain for the coordinator's visual stage. Accepted practice and quiz mathematics were not re-audited.
